cues.text: In the square by Port Island Station, a girl sits on a bench drawing in a sketchbook. Junpei walks up to her, his bag over his shoulder, and stops beside the bench.
Junpei rubs the back of his head. Chidori smiles, closes her sketchbook and gets up from the bench, holding it against her.
Chidori walks off past Junpei. He turns to watch her go.
Alone, Junpei pumps his fist, grinning.
